cast/double/malformed-string.reason: double() cast over a string column — same whole-string-versus-leading-digits divergence as the int() cast over a string: Cannot translate double(): SQL CAST does not reproduce CEL conversion semantics — it reads a numeric prefix where CEL requires the whole string and raises otherwise, and PostgreSQL and MySQL round where CEL truncates toward zero. The adapter rejects the shape instead of returning rows the PDP denies.
